text:
liam: Kicking off a small canary deploy for slice-4 now (11:30 PT). ETA ~10m. Maya you on smoke? Rollback window 15m after deploy finishes.

maya: Yep, I'm on. Which quick checks do you want me to run? p95, errors, model fallbacks?

liam: Short list: 1) /health 2) p95 latency for /v1/generate (route slice-4) 3) error rate > 1% alarm 4) model fallback count 5) kv-cache hit rate. If anything looks off, call rollback.

maya: Got it. I'll run the curl + small latency script and post results.

ops-bot: deploy-service: Canary rollout started for deployment/serve-slice-4 by liam. Change-ID: ch_0b1c. Track: https://deploys.redwood-inference/internal/ch_0b1c :robot_face:

alex-devops: pushed a tiny config tweak to autoscaler (minReplicas: 2 -> 3) before the rollout to avoid small cold starts. No model code changes.

maya: smoke checks (runbook):
```bash
# basic health
curl -fsS -m3 https://api.internal.redwood/v1/health || echo FAIL

# generate latency sample (5 reqs)
for i in {1..5}; do time curl -s -X POST https://api.internal.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"input":"test"}'; done
```

maya: health: OK
maya: p95 sample (5 reqs): 280ms, 310ms, 295ms, 285ms, 300ms -> p95 ~305ms (within target 350ms)
maya: error rate (last 5m): 0.2%
maya: model fallbacks: 0 for slice-4
maya: kv-cache hit rate: 72%

nora: Dashboard link for quick watch: https://grafana.redwood/d/xyz/slice-4-smoke
nora: I've pinned alerts for p95>350ms and errors>1% for the next 20m.

sre-kim: If we need to rollback: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/serve-slice-4` — I'll stand by to approve and run if you call it.

liam: Nice. No red flags so far. Rolling the rest of canary batch in 3m.

ops-bot: deploy-service: Canary batch 1 -> batch 2 progressing (50% of targets).

maya: quick sanity after batch 2: p95 ~320ms, error rate 0.4%, fallbacks 0. Two minor 502s in logs around 11:36, investigating now.

alex-devops: I see the 502s in envoy logs, likely transient due to one pod restarting during scaling. Increasing readinessProbe timeout for slice pods to 10s as a quick mitigation.

maya: rechecked - 502s gone after probe tweak, traffic stable.

liam: Good. Keep watch for next 10m. If next window OK, we'll finish rollout.

nora: Monitoring shows stable qps and token cost per request steady. I'll record metrics and send a short note to #deploys after closure.

ops-bot: deploy-service: Canary rollout completed successfully. 100% targets updated.

maya: Final verification: p95 315ms, errors 0.3%, cache 70%. All checks green. :thumbsup:

sre-kim: Marking rollback not required. Logging this as a successful canary.

liam: Awesome — thanks team. Filing follow-up with perf samples and a note to adjust readiness probe default for this family.

nora: I'll file the post-deploy summary and attach the metric snapshots.

liam: Closing thread in 30m unless someone needs follow-up. :eyes:
